## Architecture Guidance Metadata

```yaml
guidance_id: 'GUID-SEC-<CAPABILITY>-CAP-MAP-0.N.NN'
guidance_name: '{security_capability_name} Capability Map'
guidance_type: 'capability-map'
parent_vision: '<GUID-SEC-*-VISION-0.N.NN>'
adm_phase: 'Phase B'
category: 'security'
version: '0.1.0'
status: 'draft'
applicability: 'enterprise'
tags: ['security', '<capability-tag>', 'capability-map', 'phase-b']
author: '<Author Name>'
```

---

> **TOGAF ADM Note — Phase B (Business Architecture)**: This document defines the L1 and L2 capability model for the {security_capability_name} domain. It is a **non-ABB artifact** — it does not define Architecture Building Blocks, interfaces, controls, or implementation detail. It is the authoritative capability reference consumed by Phase B Business Architecture and used to derive L3 ABBs in Phases C–D.
>
> **This content does NOT define Architecture Building Blocks (ABBs).** ABBs are defined in the Composite ABB document for this domain: [<GUID-SEC-*-ABB-1.N.NN>](<relative-path-to-composite-abb>.md). For strategic context and scope boundaries, refer to the Architecture Vision: [<GUID-SEC-*-VISION-0.N.NN>](<relative-path-to-vision>.md).
